heading: •Lord Sidious (V)
notes: Group: Imperial Senate. Unique. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1102 crop) — a Dark Jedi Master CHARACTER printed over the printed EFFECT Emperor’s Power. Top to bottom: (1) title bar of a Dark character frame (blue-grey with red glow at right): round disc = Dark Jedi Master (red lightsaber blade on black) → affiliation 'Dark Jedi Master', disc 'dark-jedi'; title '•Lord Sidious'; destiny 1. (2) Lore box: the slip prints its OWN lore 'Leader. Trade Federation.' — 'Leader.' set larger/heavier than 'Trade Federation.'; the 350 px VB5 reissue shows 'Leader.' bold → lore '*Leader*. Trade Federation.'; printed Emperor’s Power lore kept in base_lore. Right of the lore box: the Death Star II expansion ring (blue/red streak sphere, as printed) AND a black EPISODE I icon below it (NOT on the printed Emperor’s Power) → ring_icons ['episode1']. (3) Art window blank white (art from the printed card; the white also covers the copyright margin). (4) Stat boxes POWER 5 / ABILITY 7 / DARK JEDI MASTER (label-only); deploy 6 / forfeit 8; game text 5 lines; inline gold/white striped sphere before 'Leia' = Original Virtual Set 3 sphere (matched against assets/icons/ovs-set-3.png; Leia (V) is VS3 #12) → {ovs:3}; the stub drops it ('Immune to Leia'). Icon column: warrior (blaster on cyan). VS16 sphere. (5) Caption '•Emperor’s Power (V)' (curly ’), number 46. Frame proportions match the printed card (banner/text box not raised — not a tall slip). Stub 'Lord Sidious (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)' (stub notes say 'Dark Jedi Master. Trade Federation.' — the slip prints 'Leader. Trade Federation.'). CHANGES vs Decipher Emperor’s Power (Death Star II, Effect, DS2-D-emperorspower.gif): card type Effect → Character (Dark Jedi Master); title; destiny 5 → 1; lore replaced; Episode I icon added; banner EFFECT → stats POWER 5 / ABILITY 7 / DARK JEDI MASTER, deploy 6 / forfeit 8; game text replaced (printed: 'Deploy on your Throne Room. You may not Force drain here. While Emperor here, opponent’s characters are deploy +2 to Death Star II sites and, once per turn, you may lose Effect (or 1 Force from top of Reserve Deck) to add one battle destiny anywhere. (Immune to Alter.)'); warrior icon added. Base lore matches the wiki and the scan. Base scan only 350 px; copyright line read off it as the SE-style form with 2000 ('© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.'). Modern: VB5-D-lordsidious-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 5 reissue of this slip, same text). Not downloaded: V8-D-lordsidious.gif (a different PC card, V8 Lord Sidious) and VB3-D-emperorspower (the VS11 Emperor’s Power (V)).
